verdict.rationale: Yapily is an open banking API platform, and a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for its SDKs, dashboard or platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics collection or any opt-out control. The consent features shown cover end-user authorisation to access bank data, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
